meetings.title: Board education session
meetings.summary: Board education session covering the existing Capital Group Emerging Markets Debt allocation and the prospective Capital Income Builder mandate. John Fernandez probed income durability; William Caldwell focused on fee governance.

decisions.text: Advance the Capital Income Builder mandate to a fee discussion.

action_items.text: Prepare fee proposal for the Capital Income Builder mandate

transcript_excerpt.speaker: William Caldwell
transcript_excerpt.text: If the fees work for the board, we're open to the income mandate.

transcript_excerpt.speaker: Sofia Marchetti
transcript_excerpt.text: I'll prepare a fee proposal tailored to the Income Builder allocation.
